About us:
Build the future of banking.

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 
 
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
 
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
 
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
 
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and X.
 

About the Role:
 
Zeta is building out its Security Operations Centre function, running on AWS OpenSearch as our core SIEM. We are looking for a SOC L2 Analyst with a strong investigative mindset and hands-on comfort operating without a traditional GUI-driven workflow — this role requires fluency in query languages to search, correlate, and triage data directly.
You'll be one of the early analysts shaping detection and response practices across a modern, cloud-native, hybrid environment spanning Kubernetes microservices, multi-cloud infrastructure, and traditional corporate IT.
 
You will be investigating and monitoring across:
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (primary hosting for all workloads/resources), Azure (logs), Kubernetes microservices
  • Edge/CDN & Network Security: Cloudflare
  • Endpoint: Microsoft Defender (corporate IT), macOS endpoints
  • Primary OS for incidents: Linux (majority of incident volume), with Windows/macOS corporate IT coverage
  • SIEM: AWS OpenSearch (query-language driven — no dedicated analysis GUI)

1. Monitoring & Escalation Handling
  • Perform full-time monitoring alongside L1, actively working the alert queue during high-volume periods, while also handling escalations from L1 analysts.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for all L1-escalated alerts and incidents; receive and validate escalated alerts/incidents, performing deeper investigation to confirm scope, impact, and root cause.
  • Perform detailed investigation, log correlation, and root-cause analysis across multiple data sources — AWS, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, Azure logs, Defender, and Linux/macOS endpoints.
  • Write and run OpenSearch Query DSL / Lucene queries directly against raw log data to pivot, correlate, and build full incident timelines (this is the primary analysis method — there is no GUI-driven investigation path).
  • Determine incident severity, scope, and business impact; validate true positive vs. false positive at a deeper level.
  • Escalate confirmed major/high-severity incidents to the L3/Incident Response team or CSIRT leadership per the incident response plan, including a full technical summary, supporting evidence, and recommended actions.
  • Coordinate with L3/Incident Response teams for complex or high-severity incidents.
    • 2. Threat Analysis & Detection Support
  • Conduct threat hunting based on IOCs, IOAs, and threat intelligence feeds.
  • Support ideation and testing of new detection use cases, correlation rules, and dashboards, in coordination with the detection engineering/L3 team.
  • Identify and report logging/health issues (e.g., missing logs, parser errors, data source outages) for timely resolution.
  • Tune and recommend improvements to detection rules, correlation logic, and SIEM use cases based on false positives/negatives observed during investigations; develop tested tuning solutions and hand them to L3 analysts and build teams for deployment.
  • Create new detection use cases, tune existing correlation rules, build/modify dashboards, develop and refine UEBA rules, and map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework for coverage visibility.
    • 3. Playbook, SOP & Knowledge Management
  • Develop and refine investigation steps for scenarios not covered by existing playbooks, and document these as new/updated runbooks for L1 use.
  • Update and improve SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge base articles based on incident learnings.
    • 4. L1 Oversight & Mentoring
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1 analysts, including alert triage decisions and use of investigation tools.
  • Own L1 shift handovers, and train/mentor L1 analysts on alert handling and escalation.
  • Review quality of L1 alert closures and escalations; provide feedback and coaching.
  • Support training and onboarding of L1 analysts on tools, triage procedures, and escalation criteria.
  • Ensure smooth shift handovers between L1 and L2, and across shifts.
    • 5. Compliance & Audit Support
  • Assist with compliance and audit requests requiring deeper technical evidence or investigation summaries.
    • 6. Continuous Learning & Feedback
  • Continuously expand knowledge of emerging threats, attack techniques, and best practices through ongoing training and self-study.
  • Stay current on emerging threats, TTPs, and vulnerabilities relevant to our environment, and translate this into actionable detection improvements.
    • "},{"text":"Skills:","content":"
     
  • Strong working knowledge of SIEM query languages — direct experience with OpenSearch Query DSL, Lucene syntax, KQL, SPL, or equivalent is essential (you must be comfortable querying raw data without relying on prebuilt dashboards)
  • Solid Linux investigation skills — process, network, and log-level analysis on Linux hosts is core to this role
  • Practical understanding of cloud security fundamentals, ideally AWS (IAM, CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, GuardDuty, etc.)
  • Exposure to Kubernetes/container security concepts (pod logs, k8s audit logs, common container attack patterns)
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare logs (WAF, DNS, edge traffic) or similar CDN/edge security tooling
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender and basic Windows/macOS endpoint investigation
  • Strong analytical and investigative mindset — able to pivot from a single alert to a full incident narrative using raw log data
  • Understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attack patterns (cloud, container, endpoint), including mapping detections for coverage visibility
  • Experience acting as an escalation point for L1 analysts — validating their triage, coaching on quality, and owning shift handovers
  • Ability to author and maintain runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles from incident learnings
  • Clear, structured incident documentation and communication skills
    • "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications:","content":"
  • 3–5 years of hands-on SOC experience, with at least 1–2 years in an L2 analyst capacity handling escalations independently
  • Bachelor of Technology (BE/B.Tech), M.Tech/ME in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Prior SOC experience in a fintech, banking, or regulated industry environment
  • Exposure to Azure Sentinel/Azure logs in addition to AWS
  • Scripting ability (Python, Bash) for automation of repetitive investigation tasks
  • Certifications such as Security+, GCIH, GCIA, CySA+, or equivalent
  • Experience contributing to detection engineering (writing/tuning correlation rules, not just consuming them)
  • Familiarity with case management/ticketing tools (e.g., TheHive, Jira, ServiceNow)
  • Experience developing or tuning UEBA rules
  • Experience identifying and reporting log pipeline health issues (missing sources, parser errors, ingestion outages)
  • Experience supporting compliance/audit evidence requests (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, RBI/regulatory — relevant to fintech)

    About Us

    Build the future of banking.

    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

     Our Impact and Growth

    Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in Jan 1, 2025.

     Our Product Lines

    Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
     
    1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
    2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
    3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
    4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
    5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
    6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
    …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

     Our Culture and Values

    We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.

    If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.

    Learn More About Zeta

    If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.

    About the Role

    Zeta is seeking an Associate Director – Legal to serve as a strategic advisor within its legal team. The role supports the company's technology business, including its SaaS platforms for banks and financial institutions, as it scales across India, the US, the UK, and other global markets.This is a high-impact, product-facing role for a seasoned lawyer with deep expertise in technology contracts and a strong understanding of the banking and financial services sector that Zeta's platforms serve.
     
    The role involves making sure Zeta's products, partnerships, and client engagements are structured and delivered in a legally sound way. Reporting to Zeta's India legal leadership, the Associate Director will work closely with the Product, Sales, Engineering, Compliance, and Information Security teams, with significant autonomy and visibility. The ideal candidate will own matters end to end, negotiate directly with clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, and lead a team of capable lawyers. They will also help shape the legal function of a fast-growing global technology company.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate B2B SaaS contracts, outsourcing contracts, software development agreements, license agreements, and managed-services, partnership, and third-party vendor agreements with clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, making sure they align with legal and business requirements.

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on all aspects of technology contracts.

  • While anchored in technology law, provide practical legal advice across all matters that affect the business, including corporate, commercial, employment, and intellectual property issues, and offer innovative solutions to minimize and manage legal risks across jurisdictions.

  • Manage the input from internal stakeholders that is needed to draft and review critical agreements.

  • Lead and mentor a team of lawyers, overseeing the quality and turnaround of contract reviews and negotiations.

  • Constantly improve the legal team's templates and playbooks, drawing on learnings from each client engagement.

  • Act as a business enabler, keeping the legal team aligned with Zeta's speed of delivery and culture of teamwork.

  • Execution and prioritization: Highly organized and detail-oriented; manages multiple matters simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth setting; ability to leverage AI for legal work highly preferred.

  • Team leadership and people management: Ability to lead and manage a team effectively.

  • Ownership and adaptability: Proactive self-starter, energized by ambiguity, comfortable in unfamiliar areas of law, takes ownership of outcomes, thrives in a collaborative, product-driven culture.

  • Excellent grasp of the laws and market practices that apply to technology agreements, intellectual property, and data protection.

  • Strong contract drafting, review, and negotiation skills across B2B SaaS, outsourcing contracts, software licensing, software development, IT services, and IP licensing agreements.

  • Understanding of the nuances of technology agreements in the banking and financial services sector, with exposure to cross-border matters.

  • Proven experience leading and managing a team, including handling administrative responsibilities alongside substantive legal work.

    About the Role:

    As a Cloud Security & DevSecOps Engineer II, you will play a key role in strengthening the security posture of our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/container platforms and software delivery ecosystem. 

    You will work closely with Cloud/Platform, SRE, DevOps, Engineering, Product Security and Risk & Compliance teams to identify and mitigate security risks, build scalable security controls, automate recurring security activities and drive security findings through remediation and closure. 

    The role covers Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), IAM & Access Governance, DevSecOps, Kubernetes Security, Infrastructure Security, Vulnerability Management, Security Monitoring, Security Automation and Compliance Engineering, while also contributing to broader Information Security initiatives across the organisation.

    ","id":"a83bd184-4c9b-42b8-a6d4-7be310774a6a","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    • Perform continuous security posture assessments across AWS, Azure and GCP environments and identify cloud misconfigurations, insecure configurations and deviations from security baselines. 

    • Conduct IAM and SSO access reviews, covering users, roles, groups, service accounts/service principals, permissions, access keys and privileged access, and identify excessive or stale access. 

    • Identify and assess publicly exposed cloud resources, insecure network configurations and unnecessary external exposure across compute, storage, databases, load balancers and other cloud services. 

    • Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, Infrastructure-as-Code scanning, container/image scanning, DAST and software supply-chain controls. 

    • Perform Infrastructure-as-Code security reviews and support secure implementation of Terraform and similar technologies. 

    • Perform Kubernetes and container security assessments, including cluster configurations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload security, image security, hardening and security posture management. 

    • Analyse vulnerabilities and security findings, validate risks and false positives, prioritise remediation and work with Engineering/SRE/DevOps teams to drive findings through closure. 

    • Develop security automation using Python, Bash, cloud APIs and CLIs for IAM reviews, asset inventories, security assessments, compliance checks, monitoring, reporting and evidence collection. 

    • Review cloud network and edge security controls including VPC/VNet, Security Groups/firewalls, load balancers, WAF, TLS/mTLS and public/private connectivity. 

    • Monitor and review CloudSEK alerts and findings, perform initial analysis and validation, and coordinate remediation or escalation with relevant stakeholders. 

    • Support CloudSEK block-rule activities, including review and validation of relevant indicators, domains and URLs, and coordinate appropriate blocking actions with responsible teams. 

    • Support investigation of cloud and security alerts, exposed credentials, suspicious access, provider security notifications and other security events. 

    • Participate in cloud architecture and design security reviews and provide practical security recommendations based on risk, secure-by-design and least-privilege principles. 

    • Support security and audit requirements aligned with frameworks such as CIS, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP. 

    • Develop and maintain security standards, SOPs, hardening guidelines, assessment methodologies, technical documentation and operational runbooks. 

    • Continuously identify opportunities to automate preventive and detective security controls and improve overall Cloud Security and DevSecOps maturity. 

    • Participate in broader Information Security activities including vulnerability management, security assessments, incident investigations, security reviews, audit/compliance.

    "},{"text":"Skills","content":"

    To be successful in this role, you should have: 

    • Strong hands-on understanding of at least one major public cloud platform, preferably AWS, with working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP being an advantage. 

    • Good understanding of cloud security across IAM, compute, storage, networking, encryption, logging and monitoring. 

    • Knowledge of cloud security services such as AWS IAM/IAM Identity Center, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS and EKS, or equivalent services in Azure/GCP. 

    • Hands-on understanding of CI/CD and DevSecOps security, including SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning, IaC scanning and container/image security. 

    • Experience with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent platforms. 

    • Working knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code security. 

    • Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, Kubernetes RBAC, container security and cluster hardening. 

    • Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash or similar languages. 

    • Strong understanding of IAM, least privilege, MFA, privileged access, credential management and access governance. 

    • Understanding of CSPM, KSPM, CWPP and CNAPP concepts. 

    • Knowledge of cloud/network security concepts including VPC/VNet, Security Groups, firewalls, WAF, TLS/mTLS and private/public connectivity. 

    • Experience with security monitoring, alert triage and threat/exposure-management platforms such as CloudSEK or equivalent solutions. 

    • Exposure to security tooling such as Snyk or equivalent SAST/SCA, CSPM, container and infrastructure security solutions. 

    • Understanding of vulnerability management, risk-based remediation and security incident investigation. 

    • Knowledge of security standards and frameworks including CIS Benchmarks, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP. 

    • Ability to independently analyse security findings, document security risks and provide clear and practical remediation recommendations to technical stakeholders. 

    "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications","content":"

    • 3–6 years of relevant experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security or related security engineering roles. 

    • Strong hands-on technical experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management and security automation. 

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience. 

    • Relevant cloud/security certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer or equivalent are an added advantage.

    About Zeta:

    Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 

    Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 

     

    About the Role 

    Zeta solves hard problems for financial institutions. We assemble solutions from our processing, issuing, payments, lending, core, and digital banking platforms to answer a problem an institution could not solve with what it already owns. 

    Every processor now says modern, API-first, and cloud-native, so the words no longer separate vendors. Buyers compare proof, and each alternative asks them to accept a compromise: a provider too old to move fast, one too new to trust with credit, or a program that is never really theirs. 

    This role joins two jobs that are usually split. The first is product: deciding which solutions go to banks, sponsor banks, and fintechs, how they are packaged and priced, and what gets built next. The second is solutions engineering: discovery, target architecture, proofs, and defending the design through architecture, security, and procurement review. 

    You hold both jobs with equal weight: product owner for a defined portfolio of solutions, and the person who proves them in the room. You own the strategy for your solutions and the case for what the platform builds next, and you keep every deal from becoming a custom build. This is a hands-on, 0 to 1 role with no team at the start but requires mentoring and working teams of engineers and product managers.  

    ","id":"fe9b2558-10da-4a2c-907f-0dee2a1d76be","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    Know the Stack 

    • Learn the full Zeta stack hands-on, from issuing across credit, debit, and prepaid to core banking, lending, payments, fraud, and agentic AI end to end 

    • Reach the depth of the teams that build it: modules, APIs, low-code extension points, events, data model, and deployment, each used yourself the way a customer or engineer would 

    Own the Solution 

    • Set the product strategy for your portfolio: which segments and recurring problems to serve, which solutions to build, and which to refuse or retire 

    • Design the product, not only the architecture, for a named institution: customer, proposition, program structure, economics, compliance model, and operating model, before any integration is written 

    • Settle who carries each obligation in a bank and fintech program (onboarding, underwriting, monitoring, disputes, reporting), in writing a bank's compliance officer will sign 

    • Build the business case beside the technical one: unit economics, fees, reserves, and more 

    • Turn the second and third engagement of the same shape into a packaged solution with a defined scope, price logic, positioning, and launch checklist, then run it with its own roadmap and adoption measures 

    • Close the loop with the market: win and loss reviews, customer discovery, and usage, feeding product requirements and the case to the platform teams for what gets built next 

    Discovery, Architecture, and Coexistence 

    • Run technical discovery inside large estates and find the problem worth solving 

    • Produce the target architecture and integration design against the institution's existing core, ledger, data, and channel systems, as one proposition across several platforms, with clear scope now and later 

    • Design coexistence and phasing: what moves first, what runs in parallel, what is decommissioned 

    • Design side-by-side, product-by-product conversion paths for programs and banks with an existing book, scoped with delivery teams 

    Demos and Proofs 

    • Build and maintain demo environments across credit, prepaid, and debit, for new programs and conversions, showing the workflows a customer actually runs 

    • Run proofs of concept and bake-offs against criteria you helped the customer write 

    Enterprise Evaluation and Oversight 

    • Own technical RFP and RFI responses, security questionnaires, and vendor due diligence 

    • Carry the case through architecture review, security, and procurement 

    • Own the technical answer to sponsor bank oversight: every program visible as it runs, ledger-level access on demand, every action recorded as an event, and complete files in hours. 

    Market Voice, and Handoff 

    • Act as counterpart to a buyer’s technical leadership through evaluation, integration design, and launch 

    • Build sponsor banks and fintech platforms into repeatable channels 

    • Keep a working analysis of the field by cohort: legacy full-stack, modern words on older cores, newer platforms without a scaled revolving book, and program managers with capital 

    • Work with Marketing on positioning and case studies, and speak at industry forums 

    "},{"text":"Key Performance Metrics ","content":"

    What you build and own: 

    • A strategy and roadmap for your solutions portfolio, agreed with the platform roadmap owners and built on win and loss evidence 

    • At least three packaged solutions for recurring institutional problems, each with scope, compliance model, economics, pricing, and launch path written down, and each usable by a seller without you 

    • A demo, reference architecture, and objection log library a new seller can run alone, covering diverse solutions spanning credit, prepaid, and debit 

    • Product requirements traced to named deals, in a form the platform teams can plan against, with proposed roadmap items committed and shipped 

    • At least one banking service provider or sponsor bank partner whose own team can position and demonstrate our capability unaided 

    What you contribute to: 

    • Qualified institutions reaching technical evaluation, wins in proofs of concept, and new RFP and shortlist inclusion 

    • At least one seven-figure ARR contract, with a technically qualified pipeline behind it 

    • At least one program live on a solution you designed 

    • One conversion of an existing book, from first technical conversation to signed decision 

    • One institutional reference willing to talk to another bank's architects 

    "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications ","content":"

    • 12+ years across technology and commercial roles, combining more than one of engineering, product, solutions engineering, and customer success, in banking or fintech 

    • Owned a product or solution line across strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and launch 

    • Defined or launched a financial product with a bank, sponsor bank, fintech, or payments company, from compliance review to live customers 

    • Sold or built technology for US banks, credit unions, fintechs, program managers, or sponsor banks, carrying deals through architecture, security, and procurement review, with a working grasp of sponsor bank oversight and third-party risk 

    • Hands-on card issuing and processing, with credit depth strongly preferred: revolving balances, interest and fee logic, delinquency, and the ledger beneath them 

    • Breadth across at least 2 of core, deposits, payments, cards, lending, and digital 

    • Preferred: running a product or solutions function at a sponsor bank, bank-fintech platform, or payments company; core migration in a live institution; a technical degree 

     
     
    "},{"text":"Skills","content":"
     

    • Product judgment: decide what to build for one, what to package for many, and what to refuse, and say why to a customer who wants all three 

    • Market sense: turn buyer, competitor, and win and loss evidence into a position, price, and roadmap 

    • Program, compliance, and economics fluency: read a bank-fintech arrangement as a sponsor bank's risk officer does, and design interest, fees, interchange, and reserves into a product that holds up 

    • Technical breadth with depth: command the architecture, APIs, and data model across enough of the stack to assemble one proposition from several platforms 

    • Architectural judgment: design a target state, sequence the path, and defend both live against an institution's architects

    About Zeta:

    Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 

    Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 

     

    About the Role 

    Zeta solves hard problems for financial institutions. We assemble solutions from our processing, issuing, payments, lending, core, and digital banking platforms to answer a problem an institution could not solve with what it already owns. 

    Every processor now says modern, API-first, and cloud-native, so the words no longer separate vendors. Buyers compare proof, and each alternative asks them to accept a compromise: a provider too old to move fast, one too new to trust with credit, or a program that is never really theirs. 

    This role joins two jobs that are usually split. The first is product: deciding which solutions go to banks, sponsor banks, and fintechs, how they are packaged and priced, and what gets built next. The second is solutions engineering: discovery, target architecture, proofs, and defending the design through architecture, security, and procurement review. 

    You hold both jobs with equal weight: product owner for a defined portfolio of solutions, and the person who proves them in the room. You own the strategy for your solutions and the case for what the platform builds next, and you keep every deal from becoming a custom build. This is a hands-on, 0 to 1 role with no team at the start but requires mentoring and working teams of engineers and product managers.

    About Us

    Build the future of banking.

    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

     Our Impact and Growth

    Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia.     …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

    We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech.     About the Role 

    We are looking for a senior technology leader to lead Zeta’s digital transformation across its Enterprise Applications, Software Solutions, Integration, AI, IT Infrastructure, and Operations landscape. 

    The role sits at the intersection of enterprise applications, software engineering, integration architecture, AI-enabled automation, IT infrastructure, service management, cybersecurity, and technology operations. The leader will ensure that Zeta’s technology ecosystem is integrated, scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with business objectives. 

    The primary charter is to connect and optimize the existing technology ecosystem — integrating SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications; building bridge systems and software solutions where required; and selectively applying AI and automation to improve workflows, data movement, operational efficiency, and user experience. 

    Alongside this, the role provides strategic and operational oversight of IT infrastructure and IT operations, including networks, endpoints, cloud, Microsoft 365, service desk, application support, reliability, security, and technology governance.

     Enterprise Applications & Technology Strategy 

    • Own the roadmap for the organization's Enterprise Application ecosystem, including SaaS, on-premise, cloud, legacy, and internally developed applications. 

    • Oversee business-critical platforms including Project Management, Collaboration, HRMS, Payroll, ATS, LMS, Telephony, and internally developed applications. 

    • Evaluate existing technology capabilities and determine whether requirements should be addressed through configuration, integration, automation, AI, or custom software development. 

    • Drive application lifecycle management, modernization, consolidation, and optimization. 

    • Lead technology evaluations, vendor selection, RFI/RFP processes, POCs, negotiations, renewals, and vendor performance management. 

    Software Development, Integration & Bridge Systems 

    • Lead and mentor application and software engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, and supporting business-critical solutions. 

    • Oversee the complete software lifecycle from requirements and architecture through development, integration, testing, deployment, and operations. 

    • Define and oversee enterprise integration architecture across applications, including APIs, middleware, data pipelines, SSO, event-driven integrations, and workflow orchestration. 

    • Identify gaps between existing platforms and oversee the development of bridge applications, middleware, APIs, and integration services to connect disparate systems. 

    • Ensure new applications and solutions integrate into the broader enterprise ecosystem rather than creating additional technology silos. 

    • Establish standards for software architecture, development, testing, security, deployment, observability, and maintainability. 

    AI & Intelligent Automation 

    • Identify practical opportunities to apply AI, AI agents, LLMs, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration across the existing application ecosystem. 

    • Use AI to enhance application integration, automate data movement and business processes, and create intelligent interfaces between systems. 

    • Oversee the development of AI-enabled bridge solutions that can interpret, transform, route, and orchestrate information across multiple applications. 

    • Evaluate AI solutions alongside conventional integration and automation approaches, selecting the appropriate technology for each business problem. 

    • Establish appropriate governance around AI, data access, security, privacy, and operational reliability. 

     IT Infrastructure Strategy & Operations 

    • Provide strategic and operational oversight of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, endpoints, cloud services, collaboration platforms, Microsoft 365, identity, and core technology platforms. 

    • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, resilient, secure, and capable of supporting the organization's application and digital transformation roadmap. 

    • Partner with infrastructure and engineering teams to design and maintain reliable application and infrastructure environments. 

    • Oversee infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, capacity planning, lifecycle management, and technology resilience. 

    • Ensure infrastructure architecture supports the organization's integration, software, data, and AI initiatives. 

     IT Operations, Service Management & Reliability 

    • Provide leadership across IT Operations, Service Desk, Application Support, Infrastructure Operations, and technology service management. 

    • Ensure high availability, reliability, performance, and supportability across applications, infrastructure, integrations, and critical technology services. 

    • Establish and monitor SLAs, operational KPIs, incident management, problem management, change management, release management, and service improvement processes. 

    • Establish appropriate monitoring and observability across applications, APIs, integrations, infrastructure, and AI-enabled workflows. 

    • Drive automation and data-driven operational practices to improve service quality and reduce manual intervention. 

    • Ensure a strong employee technology experience across the organization. 

    Security, Compliance & Technology Governance 

    • Ensure application, infrastructure, integration, data, and AI environments adhere to applicable security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. 

    • Partner with cybersecurity teams to maintain appropriate controls across applications, infrastructure, integrations, cloud environments, and endpoints. 

    • Ensure compliance with frameworks including ISO 27001, SOC 2, and applicable data protection regulations. 

    • Establish technology governance covering architecture, applications, integrations, AI, infrastructure, vendors, and operational risk. 

    • Own and optimize the technology budget across applications, software development, infrastructure, and operations. 

    Data, Analytics & Automation 

    • Define and oversee enterprise data architecture and data engineering pipelines across business systems. 

    • Build analytics and dashboards providing visibility into application usage, operational performance, adoption, service levels, integration health, and technology costs. 

    • Drive automation across application, infrastructure, and service management functions. 

    • Leverage data and AI to identify operational inefficiencies and continuously improve technology services. 

    Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration 

    • Build, lead, mentor, and scale high-performing teams across Enterprise Applications, Software Engineering, Integration, Infrastructure, IT Operations, and Service Management. 

    • Establish clear ownership, accountability, delivery standards, and performance metrics across technology teams. 

    • Partner closely with business, security, finance, HR, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into integrated technology solutions. 

    • Lead cross-functional transformation programs from strategy through execution, ensuring delivery within scope, timeline, and budget.

    About Zeta
    Build the future of banking. 

    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers.     Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025. 

    Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including: 

    1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems 

    2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments 

    3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI 

    4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking. 

    5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024. 

    6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US 

    …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking. 

    We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. 

    If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground. If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.

    About the Role

    The Manager – Accounts will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end finance operations including Accounts Payable, General Ledger, month-end close, statutory and group audits, treasury operations, and providing finance support for corporate restructuring initiatives across Zeta Group entities.

    The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, leadership capability, and the ability to operate in a fast-growing, multi-entity environment.

    An ambitious individual who can deal with ambiguity and is interested in working for a growth-phase company would be an ideal fit for the role.

    1. Financial Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Own and manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and reconciliations.
  • Ensure compliance with Ind AS / IFRS and Group accounting policies.
  • Monitor balance sheet integrity and drive resolution of open items.

    • 2. Accounts Payable & Payments

  • Oversee Accounts Payable operations, including vendor accounting, invoice processing, and aging management.
  • Ensure timely processing of vendor payments in line with agreed credit terms and internal controls.
  • Review and approve bank payments through ERP and banking platforms.
  • Drive process improvements and automation in AP workflows.

    • 3. General Ledger & Controls

    • Lead the General Ledger function across multiple entities.
    • Ensure robust internal controls, SOPs, and documentation.
    • Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve accounting issues and improve data quality.

      • 4. Audits & Compliance

      • Act as the primary point of contact for statutory, internal, and group audits.
      • Coordinate audit planning, data readiness, and closure of audit queries.
      • Ensure timely completion of audits with minimal adjustments and no major qualifications.
      • Support compliance with statutory requirements, including filings and regulatory submissions.

        • 5. Treasury & Banking

        • Oversee treasury operations, including cash flow monitoring, fund utilization, and banking relationships.
        • Manage bank accounts, signatories, and payment authorization controls.
        • Support cash forecasting and liquidity planning in coordination with leadership.

          • 6. Restructuring & Special Projects

          • Provide accounting and finance support for group restructuring, de-mergers, mergers, and internal reorganizations.
          • Assist in implementation of accounting treatments, disclosures, and audit coordination related to restructuring.
          • Support system migrations, process transitions, and finance transformation initiatives.

            • 7. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

            • Lead, mentor, and develop the finance operations team.
            • Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to timelines and quality standards.
            • Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Tax, FP&A, and Business teams.

    About Us

    Build the future of banking.

    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.
     
    Our Impact and Growth
    Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in Jan 1, 2025.

    Our Product Lines

    Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
     
    1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
    2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
    3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
    4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
    5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
    6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
    …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

    Our Culture and Values

    We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.

    If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.

    Learn More About Zeta

    If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.

    The incumbent will be part of Zeta’s talent management CoE. The individual will be expected to contribute towards building the overall talent strategy at Zeta and ensuring its translation into meaningful programs and initiatives that shape the employee experience. A key focus of the role is to work on initiatives across talent planning, career development, performance management, competency creation and engagement with the People Success team to create a culture focused on unparalleled learning and career growth.

    About the Role
    We are looking for a hands-on HR Technology professional to support the transformation of our HR tech landscape into a more integrated, scalable, and AI-ready ecosystem over the next 12–24 months. 

    The role combines ownership of existing HR systems with responsibility for driving future technology transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring strong HR process understanding, HRIS implementation and administration experience, problem-solving ability, and a passion for leveraging technology to improve HR effectiveness and employee experience. 

    This role is suited for a strong individual contributor or first-time manager who can balance day-to-day system ownership with strategic transformation initiatives.

    1. HR Technology Transformation 

  • Support the HR technology roadmap and digital transformation initiatives. 
  • Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and AI adoption. 
  • Evaluate and implement new HR technology solutions aligned to business needs. 
  • Drive process redesign and technology-enabled improvements across the employee lifecycle. 

    • 2. HR Systems Implementation & Administration 

    • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional specifications, user stories, solution designs, and system configurations. 

    • Manage implementations, enhancements, upgrades, testing, go-lives, and post-implementation support. 

    • Act as the functional owner and administrator for HR technology platforms. 

    • Manage system configurations, workflows, business rules, user roles, and permissions. 

    • Ensure platform stability, data integrity, seamless user experience, and operational excellence. 

    • Monitor system performance, manage issue resolution, and coordinate with vendors and internal teams. 

    3. Solutioning & Continuous Improvement 

    • Translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions. 

    • Identify process gaps and system limitations and recommend enhancements or workarounds. 

    • Drive system optimization, automation, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

    • Troubleshoot complex system and process issues using logical and structured problem-solving. 

    4. Governance & Vendor Management 

    • Manage vendor relationships, enhancement backlogs, SLAs, and support models. 

    • Maintain process documentation, SOPs, governance standards, and compliance requirements. 

    • Ensure timely delivery of projects, upgrades, and enhancements. 

    5. Adoption & Capability Building 

    • Drive user adoption of HR technology platforms. 

    • Conduct training and enablement sessions for HR teams and stakeholders. 

    • Promote best practices and standardized HR processes

      •  

      What Success Looks Like 

      • Existing HR systems are stable, well-governed, and effectively utilized. 

      • HR users have a reliable and seamless technology experience. 

      • Technology-driven process improvements and automations are consistently delivered. 

      • System gaps are proactively identified and addressed with practical solutions. 

      • The HR technology landscape becomes increasingly integrated, scalable, data-driven, and AI-ready over the next 12–24 months. 

      • The individual is viewed as the trusted HR technology expert and solution partner across HR and business teams.

    • Hands-on experience with configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and process automation.

    • Familiarity with integrations, workflows, automation, and AI-enabled HR solutions. 

    • Strong project management, stakeholder management, and execution skills. 

    • Good working knowledge of dashboards and reporting tools such as Tableau.

    About Zeta

    Build the future of banking.

    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

    Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.

    Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:

    1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems

    2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments

    3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI

    4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking

    5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024

    6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

    We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.

    If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.

    If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.

     

    About the Product

    Zeta is building a new consumer banking product for the US market. The focus is learning fast which features drive adoption, engagement and retention — and building them well.

     

    About the Role

    You'll help grow the product through a steady cadence of experiments and feature launches. Each PM owns a business-outcome metric for one area of the product, and the roadmap that moves it. Example areas: onboarding and activation, engagement and retention, revenue, and trust and risk.

    We need a hustler. The work will feel like a very early-stage startup: ambiguous problems, incomplete information, shifting priorities and no playbook. You'll bring structure to the chaos: find the answers, make the calls and get things shipped.

    We expect PMs to use AI tools across the lifecycle — research, specs, prototyping, analysis — to keep iteration cycles short. PMs here go deep on how things are built, so hands-on software development experience is mandatory.

    ","id":"632d6320-6db1-4504-8640-a89aed0bbd2b","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"
    1. Own a metric
  • Own a business-outcome metric for your area, plus the guardrail metrics it must not trade away.
  • Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and features, prioritised by expected impact (RICE, ICE or similar).
    • 2. Run experiments
  • Write each bet as a hypothesis with a primary metric, guardrails and a decision rule, all set before launch.
  • Match the method to the traffic: A/B tests and holdouts at scale; fake doors, usability tests and cohort analysis at low volume.
  • Size tests properly, report null and negative results as plainly as wins, and make the ship, iterate or kill call.
  • Keep a running log of what was tested, what was learned and what changed.
    • 3. Build features
  • Take features from problem definition through spec, build, QA, launch and adoption.
  • Write specs engineers can build from: flows, edge cases, failure states, event instrumentation and acceptance criteria.
  • Work through technical design with engineering — APIs, data models, ledger and payment flows, third-party integrations — and make trade-off calls quickly.
    • 4. Measure
  • Define output metrics (acquisition, activation, revenue, engagement) and the input metrics that drive them (funnel conversion, feature usage).
  • Own event instrumentation and data quality for your area.
  • Do your own analysis in SQL, product analytics tools (such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or MoEngage) and BI tools (such as Metabase or Superset).
    • 5. Research users
  • Run continuous discovery with US customers through remote interviews, usability tests and surveys.
  • Turn what you hear and what the data shows into clear problem statements that feed the backlog.
    • 6. Shape the UX
  • Partner with designers on simple flows that earn users' trust.
  • Own product copy for your area.
    • 7. Launch and support
  • Ship behind feature flags and in stages, with monitoring and a rollback plan.
  • Work with compliance, risk, banking partners, operations and support so every launch meets regulatory requirements and can be supported from day one.
    • "},{"text":"Skills","content":"
  • Statistics and experiment design: hypothesis testing, significance, power and sample sizing, and common traps such as peeking and novelty effects.
  • Strong SQL, and fluency with product analytics and BI tools.
  • Ability to work through messy data sets and turn them into decisions.
  • Engineering fundamentals you still use: reading code, system design, APIs and data models.
  • A keen eye for design, and strong UX writing.
  • Clear written and verbal communication — specs and experiment readouts people can act on.
  • Meticulous program management across parallel workstreams.
  • Hands-on experience with user research.
    • "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications","content":"
  • 6+ years of total experience, including: 3–4 years in product management, with features shipped and measured in production. At least 3 years of hands-on software development, writing and shipping production code as an engineer. This is mandatory.
  • A track record of experiments that changed a product decision.
  • Preferred: consumer fintech, payments or banking experience, ideally in the US.
  • Preferred: B2C products with a growth or experimentation focus.

    About us:
    Build the future of banking.

    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

    Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
    1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
    2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
    3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
    4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
    5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
    6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
    …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.

Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.

    If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and X.
     

    About the Role:

    This role is part of the Risk & Compliance Team, Engineering division of Zeta. The Product Security Engineer is responsible to secure all mobile & web applications along with API’s by breaking and hacking them and educating Developers as well as DevOps teams on how to fix them. The objective is to make zeta applications and platforms secure. As Application Security Engineer of the Product Security sub-division, you will be responsible for securing all the Zeta’s Products. You will be working as an individual contributor reporting to a manager.

    Perform regular VA/PT for Web & Mobile applications, API & Infrastructure

    Guide developers in fixing security issues. 

    Regular code reviews 

    Involve in application design discussions. 

    Perform Threat Modelling of Web/Mobile applications. 

    Develop secure code practices and educate dev and QA engineers by building security standards, policies for secure coding, secure data handling, secure networking, secure crypto implementation, etc. 

    Evaluate & Integrate security testing tools (SAST, DAST,SCA) in to CI/CD pipelines. 

    ","id":"e21ca17d-7bf2-4781-94bb-bcfc8943aae0","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities:","content":"

    • Guide the technology organization's security and privacy initiatives by participating in design reviews and threat modelling. 

    • The applications are developed by the developers and product managers, and you will make sure the applications are secured and hardened. 

    • You will define the scope and ensure continuous adherence to the scope of projects at each phase (initiation to sustenance/maintenance phase). 

    • You will be responsible for creating visibility, and adoption of the projects meant for internal customers. 

    • Act as a security engineering expert and technical champion within Zeta. 

    • Assess gaps, and tools to improve application security 

    • Liasoning with all external and internal stakeholders for the team. 

    • Mentoring developers and QA. 

    • Evaluate bugs reported through the Bug Bounty program. 

    • Run security posture of various applications across BU’s. 

    • Continuous improvement of web/mobile application security 

    • Quarterly VA/PT (internal/external, authenticate/non-authenticated) for mobile/web. 

    • Secure configuration of Web/Mobile application, DB, Data etc. 

    "},{"text":"Skills:","content":"

     

    • Hands on VA/PT experience in Web, Mobile, SDK, API & Network 

    • Thorough understanding of OWASP Top 10, their attack & defense mechanisms 

    • Exposure to Secure SDLC Activities, Threat Modelling & Secure Coding 

    • Experience with both commercial and open-source tools like Burp suite, AppScan, OWASP ZAP, BEEF, Metasploit, Qualys, Nessus, Synk etc. 

    • Identifying and exploiting business logic-related vulnerabilities. 

    • Solid understanding of Cryptography, knowledge of PKI-based systems, TLS 

    • Understanding of different AuthN/AuthZ frameworks (OIDC, oAuth, SAML) able to read/write/understand java code 

    • Performed Static Analysis, Code reviews using tools like Snyk, Veracode, Checkmarx, Sonarqube etc. 

    • Hands on Reversing mobile applications, class/small files, data obfuscators, or ciphers (Dex2jar, adb, Drozer, Clang, iMAS) and Dynamic Instrumentation tools like Frida/Objection 

    • Execute penetration tests and security assessments on internal and external networks, Windows and Linux environments, cloud (AWS) Infrastructure. 

    • Identify and exploit incorrect configurations and security vulnerabilities on Windows and Linux servers. Safely utilize tools, tactics, and procedures used in penetration testing engagements. 

    • Shell scripting or automation of simple tasks using Python, or Ruby 

    • Knowledge of PCI DSS, PCI SSF (S3, SSLC) etc. 

    • Knowledge of security standards like PCI DSS, UIDAI, GDPR, NIST, etc. 

    • Understanding Java Frameworks like Springboot, CI/CD, Jenkins. 

    • In-depth understanding of production operations on public cloud infrastructure. 

    • Excellent written and oral communication and a penchant for technical documentation. 

    • Must have participated in various bug bounty programs (HackerOne, Bug Crowd, Private etc) 

    • Experience in conducting hackathons and CTF’s 

    • Knowledge of AWS/Azure (VPC/Vnet, S3 buckets, blob stores, LoadBalancers etc.), Dockers & Containers, Kubernetes 

    • Good understanding of agile development practices. 

    • Certifications like OSCP(Preferred), GWAPT, Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (AWAE), Comptia Security+ 

    • Knowledge of Databases - Postgresql, Redshift, My SQL etc. and other data stores like Elasticsearch and S3 buckets. 

    • Experience in the FinTech domain is highly desirable.  

    • Knowledge of payment key management, cryptographic key handling, and HSM operations will be an added advantage. 

    • Cloudflare WAF experience or knowledge in the areas:  

    • Cloudflare WAF Rules Review and Configuration 

    • Cloudflare WAF Rules Tuning 

    • Cloudflare Traffic and Event Monitoring 

    • Bot Traffic Analysis 

    • Detecting and handling anonymous or un-authenticated API Calls.

    "},{"text":"Responsibilities ","content":"
  • Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of prepaid wallet transactions including credits, debits, and cashback.
  • Review transaction reports and statements to identify discrepancies between internal systems and external bank/partner statements.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies by coordinating with relevant teams (Operations, IT, and partners).
  • Ensure that all reconciliations are completed in a timely manner and meet compliance and audit requirements.
  • Monitor prepaid wallet balances and ensure accuracy in records and reports.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to improve reconciliation processes and system performance.
  • Manage and reconcile chargebacks, refunds, and failed transactions.
  • Prepare reports on reconciliation status and escalate unresolved issues as needed.
  • Prepare Monthly & Quarterly Regulatory Reports with accuracy & ensure submission within defined timeline.
  • Monitor daily control checks and review any observations.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of daily processes and controls to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Manage customer disputes and all the subsequent dispute lifecycle journey.

  • Own the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of PostgreSQL RDS environments across production and non-production systems.
  • Lead proactive monitoring and observability initiatives for PostgreSQL RDS instances, leveraging tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and other enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Drive advanced PostgreSQL performance tuning, including query optimization, indexing strategies, parameter tuning, and capacity planning.
  • Architect and optimize database backup, disaster recovery, and failover strategies to ensure business continuity and minimal downtime.
  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of Debezium and Kafka Connect ecosystems, ensuring robust real-time data ingestion and delivery.
  • Lead troubleshooting and optimization of ETL workflows and data pipelines, ensuring scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance across data platforms.
  • Oversee Apache Airflow workflow orchestration, ensuring high reliability, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency of production DAGs.
  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, Crossplane, and automation frameworks to streamline deployments and operational tasks.
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews for critical production issues.
  • Define and enforce database security standards, including access controls, encryption policies, compliance adherence, and periodic security audits.
  • Partner closely with engineering, DevOps, and data platform teams to optimize data architecture and improve overall platform reliability.
  • Mentor junior engineers and drive best practices across database reliability engineering and cloud data operations.
  • Identify and lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, automation, scalability, and operational maturity.

    About the role

    This role is designed for someone early in their Rewards career who wants to build deep expertise across compensation, benefits, and Rewards communications. You will work closely with the Rewards Partner to support the design, execution, and communication of Total Rewards programs across the organization. You will be the conduit between strategy and execution — owning communication, enabling change, conducting market research, and supporting large Rewards projects. 

    ","id":"b099e4fe-87cf-44ad-89b6-21edfe60958b","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    • Own the end-to-end communication strategy for all Rewards programs — including compensation cycles, benefits launches and initiatives, policy updates, and wellness initiatives

    • Build communication toolkits, FAQs, presentation decks, manager guides, and explainer materials to drive awareness and understanding of Rewards programs

    • Translate complex Rewards frameworks, pay philosophies, and policy changes into simple, engaging, and accessible content for employees, managers, and leadership

    • Partner with People Success and Internal Comms teams to ensure timely, consistent, and impactful delivery of Rewards messaging across all channels

    • Support change management planning for any major Rewards transformation (e.g., new comp structures, benefits redesign, appraisal process changes) — including stakeholder mapping, impact assessments, and rollout plans

    • Gather employee and manager feedback post-communication to assess effectiveness and continuously improve messaging strategies

    • Conduct ongoing market research and competitive benchmarking across compensation, benefits, and wellness practices — with a focus on tech, fintech, and enterpise and solutioning sector

    • Support the Rewards Partner in annual and ad hoc salary benchmarking exercises using survey data (e.g., Radford, Mercer, Korn Ferry)

    • Track industry trends in total rewards, variable pay, equity, and benefits — synthesizing insights into actionable briefs for the Rewards team and leadership

    • Build and maintain a research repository covering pay trends, competitor benefits practices, and regulatory updates across India, the US, and UAE

    • Analyze internal compensation data to identify patterns, anomalies, and equity gaps, and present findings with clear narrative and recommendations

    "},{"text":"Skills","content":"

    • Organized and detail-oriented — able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

    • Collaborative team player with a proactive attitude and eagerness to learn

    • Change management awareness — understanding of how to help people navigate organizational or program changes

    • Curiosity and innovation — you look at what others are doing and constantly ask "how can we do this better?

    • Ability to document, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs).

    • High integrity and trustworthiness — ability to handle sensitive data with discretion and confidentiality.
