    About the Role: 
    The Senior Facility Executive will be responsible for managing day-to-day facility operations, housekeeping, cafeteria and pantry services, vendor management, general administration, inventory control, and workplace upkeep. The role requires strong operational ownership, effective team coordination, proactive monitoring of service standards, timely closure of complaints, and ensuring a clean, safe, hygienic, and well-maintained workplace 
    ","id":"c3a452d5-0dbe-4ac5-b598-b6828d68cf5d","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    1. Facility Operations & Administration

    · Manage day-to-day facility operations and general administrative activities.

    · Monitor staff attendance and allocate daily tasks to shift supervisors.

    · Coordinate with shift executives to prepare duty rosters and share them with the reporting manager.

    · Conduct regular inspections of the front office, lobby, work areas, and restrooms to maintain high standards of housekeeping and upkeep.

    · Ensure newspapers and magazines are available and appropriately placed in the front office.

    · Plan and monitor weekend activities and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.

    · Prepare daily snag reports, track pending issues, and coordinate with internal teams for closure.

    · Conduct regular facility inspections and verify that completed work meets the required standards.

    · Ensure the workplace remains clean, organized, safe, and operationally ready.

    2. Housekeeping, Pantry & Cafeteria Management

    · Oversee housekeeping, cleaning, pest control, pantry, and cafeteria operations to ensure hygiene, cleanliness, and service quality.

    · Monitor housekeeping staff deployment, attendance, grooming, and work quality.

    · Ensure regular cleaning and upkeep of men's and women's restrooms, common areas, and cafeteria spaces.

    · Ensure bedspreads are sent for washing monthly and maintain appropriate records.

    · Monitor cafeteria operations, food quality, freshness, presentation, and timely service during designated meal periods.

    · Coordinate with cafeteria vendors to ensure adequate food availability, quality, hygiene, and adherence to agreed service standards.

    · Conduct regular and surprise inspections of the cafeteria, dining areas, serving counters, and other food service areas.

    · Collect employee feedback, address cafeteria-related complaints, and coordinate corrective actions with vendors.

    · Monitor food consumption, wastage, and service efficiency and identify opportunities for improvement.

    · Check pantry and housekeeping consumable stock levels, verify reorder requirements, and inform the reporting manager to initiate replenishment.

    · Prepare and submit pantry and housekeeping consumption reports.

    · Check vending machines and water coolers daily and coordinate with internal technicians to resolve faults.

    · Ensure cafeteria equipment, refrigerators, water dispensers, and other appliances are maintained in good working condition.

    3. Complaint, Snag & Escalation Management

    · Review pending complaints and action items, prioritize issues, and drive timely closure.

    · Coordinate with internal support teams and external vendors to resolve facility-related issues.

    · Maintain complaint trackers and daily snag reports, ensuring clear ownership and closure timelines.

    · Proactively identify operational challenges and keep managers informed of issues requiring escalation.

    · Track recurring complaints and coordinate corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

    · Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure service requests are resolved within agreed timelines.

     

    4. Vendor & Service Management

    · Coordinate with vendors providing housekeeping, cafeteria, pantry, pest control, and other facility-related services.

    · Monitor vendor attendance, manpower deployment, performance, and service delivery against agreed standards.

    · Verify the quality and completion of vendor work before confirming closure.

    · Conduct periodic and surprise inspections to ensure compliance with service standards.

    · Coordinate with internal technicians and relevant teams to resolve equipment faults and maintenance issues.

    · Review cafeteria and other facility vendor invoices against agreed commercial terms, services delivered, and supporting documents.

    · Maintain vendor performance records and escalate recurring service deficiencies.

    5. Inventory, Procurement & Cost Control

    · Monitor housekeeping, pantry, and cafeteria consumables and maintain adequate stock levels.

    · Track consumption, verify reorder levels, and coordinate procurement approvals with the reporting manager.

    · Maintain accurate stock registers, consumption reports, and supporting documentation.

    · Monitor food consumption and wastage and support cost-control initiatives.

    · Ensure materials and consumables are used efficiently and replenished on time.

    6. General Administration & Documentation

    · Organize, maintain, and coordinate administrative functions and departmental records.

    · Handle filing, documentation, and maintenance of facility-related reports.

    · Coordinate outdoor activities, liaison work, and follow-ups with external agencies and business stakeholders.

    · Review and process vendor bills, ensuring supporting documents and service completion details are verified.

    · Take ownership of pending follow-ups and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.

    · Prepare operational updates and reports for senior management and the reporting manager.

    · Maintain duty rosters, attendance records, inspection checklists, complaint trackers, and vendor documentation.

    7. Workplace Readiness & Flexibility 

    · Ensure smooth day-to-day operations and operational readiness of the workplace.

    · Support planned facility activities, audits, inspections, and special events as assigned.

    · Be available to support after-hours or weekend building-related activities when required.

    · Take initiative in identifying improvement opportunities and resolving operational challenges.

    · Ensure compliance with organizational policies, safety requirements, hygiene standards, and established SOPs.

    "},{"text":"Skills","content":"

    ·Excellent interpersonal, verbal communication, and customer service skills.

    · Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management abilities.

    · Ability to lead, motivate, and coordinate shift supervisors and housekeeping teams.

    · Strong vendor management and service quality monitoring skills.

    · Good problem-solving, ownership, follow-up, and escalation management capabilities.

    · Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, for reporting and operational tracking.

    · Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively

    "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications","content":"

    · Graduate degree or equivalent qualification preferred.

    · Relevant experience in facilities management, workplace operations, or general administration.

    · Experience managing housekeeping, cafeteria, pantry operations, vendors, inventory, and facility maintenance.

    · Prior experience coordinating shift teams, monitoring service standards, and handling operational escalations.

    About Us
     
    Build the future of banking.
    Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 
     
    Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
     
    Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
    1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
    2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
    3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
    4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking.
    5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024.
    6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
    …and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
     
    We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
     
    If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.

    About the Role:

    As a Technical Support Engineer for Banking Technology, you are expected to have an overall relevant experience of at least 3+ years (with at least 1 year of relevant work experience in enterprise products in a B2B banking technology company). 

    Zeta Tachyon is an Enterprise Saas Platform comprising 100+ externally consumable APIs, 10+ Customer-facing interfaces and multiple Data Extracts with more and more functionality getting added every month in a fast-paced environment. As a Technical Support Engineer for Banking Technology, you will be responsible for providing technical support and expertise to address issues and ensure the smooth operation of banking systems and technologies. 

    You will play a crucial role in providing front-line technical support to customers and internal stakeholders at the client site. You will investigate issues hands-on, analyzing logs, tracing events, troubleshooting APIs and querying data before escalating, and will work closely with Zeta’s 24×7 offshore support team.

    ","id":"147471fd-69a6-4881-aa50-d3e4b4971e82","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities:","content":"

    Customer Support & Issue Resolution 

    • Act as the primary technical contact for customer issues, delivering prompt, courteous, and professional support via email, phone, and ticketing systems. 

    • Monitor, triage, and prioritize incoming support requests based on urgency and business impact, ensuring timely resolution and high customer satisfaction. 

    Product Configuration & Maintenance 

    • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Zeta’s product suite to support seamless client onboarding and sustained operational performance. 

    Technical Operations & Protocol Handling 

    • Manage end-to-end payment transaction workflows. 

    • Write and execute SQL queries confidently and independently, and troubleshoot APIs. Familiarity with card processing protocols such as ISO 8583, Visa, and Mastercard is a plus. 

    • Troubleshoot banking systems, applications, and infrastructure issues using tools such as Postman, OpenSearch, Kibana, Splunk, Grafana, and grep. 

    Log Analysis & Root Cause Investigation 

    • Analyze system logs to identify root causes and implement effective resolutions for recurring or critical issues. 

    • Trace the history of a request or transaction across systems using correlation or transaction IDs and timestamps. 

    • Distinguish error messages from exceptions, read stack traces, and identify where and why a failure occurred. 

    • Read and navigate Grafana dashboards, understand what each dashboard monitors, and spot abnormal behavior early. 

    Cross-Functional Collaboration 

    • Work closely with engineering, product, and QA teams to investigate and resolve complex technical challenges. 

    • Ensure timely escalation, clear communication, and effective knowledge sharing across teams. 

    • When a scenario isn’t covered in the runbooks, gather the missing information from partner teams (engineering, product, database, platform and offshore support) and coordinate a resolution for the customer. 

    • Reach out early and with context when in doubt, especially before acting on production systems or customer data. 

    Documentation & Knowledge Sharing 

    • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and implementation manuals. 

    • Document common issues, resolutions, and best practices to enable self-service and improve team efficiency. 

    Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement 

    • Proactively evaluate and enhance operational workflows and support processes to drive efficiency and improve the customer experience. 

    On-Call Support 

    • Support on-call for production incidents whenever required, including outside standard business hours.

    About Zeta:

    Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 

    Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 

     

    About the Role:

    Zeta is looking for a highly entrepreneurial VP of Sales & Business Development to help build the book of business across sponsor banks, BIN sponsors, agent banks, program managers, and fintechs. This is a 0-1 role that will be responsible for creating, qualifying, progressing, and closing high-quality opportunities across debit, prepaid, credit, lending, and adjacent banking technology propositions. 

    The ideal candidate will be a hands-on business builder with strong existing relationships in the US banking, sponsor bank, and fintech ecosystem; the ability to open senior doors; and the commercial discipline to convert market access into qualified pipeline, active pursuits, and signed revenue. 

    ","id":"7c0e0301-f6e0-4092-980d-7e7ec3b566f1","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    In this role, you will: 

    • Own prospect identification, segmentation, prioritization, and outreach across named accounts based on segment attractiveness, buying intent, relationship access, fit with Zeta’s capabilities, and likelihood of conversion 

    • Open doors and establish trusted access to decision makers, sponsors, and influencers across banks, regulated financial institutions, program managers, fintechs, processors, networks, consultants, and other ecosystem participants 

    • Build & nurture qualified pipeline that meets clear standards including named prospect, named buyer or sponsor, documented use case, estimated annual contract value, and next meeting or decision milestone scheduled 

    • Drive the full deal journey for assigned opportunities spanning discovery, qualification, solution framing, pitching, pricing inputs, business case development, stakeholder mapping, procurement support, contracting support, and deal closure 

    • Anchor pre-sales engagements in partnership with the sales engineering team to create & deliver demos, POCs, tabletop-exercises, solution workshops, discovery sessions, and other impactful formats that generate traction with clients 

    • Support contracting, client onboarding, and early account activation to ensure a clean handoff from signed opportunity to delivery, implementation, and long-term account ownership 

    • Participate in events and industry fora to acquire leads, drive visibility, and awareness of Zeta’s offerings & solutions 

    • Maintain rigorous deal discipline through accurate CRM hygiene, weekly pipeline reviews, opportunity plans, stakeholder maps, next-step tracking, forecast updates and more 

    • Contribute market intelligence, buyer feedback, competitor insights, pricing signals, and product input to help refine Zeta’s proposition, right to play, and right to win in this segment 

    "},{"text":"Key Performance Metrics ","content":"

    Success in the initial 18 months will be measured by: 

    • Success in building qualified pipeline as measured by # of qualified opportunities, estimated annual contract value, documented use cases, named buyer or sponsor access, and scheduled decision milestones 

    • Establishing Zeta’s right to play as measured by # of senior meetings, # of pre-sales engagements, # of active opportunities, and # of RFP or opportunity participations 

    • Establishing Zeta’s right to win in this segment as measured by meaningful contribution to at least 2 USD 7-figure ARR client wins 

    "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications","content":"

    • 15+ years' experience; with at least 5+ years as a partner or sales leader with a proven track record in building a multi-million $ book of business ground up in the US financial services sector 

    • Significant experience selling to both banks and regulated financial institutions as well as fintechs at a banking technology company or IT services provider 

    • Strong rolodex and meaningful inroads with decision makers at US sponsor banks & fintechs 

    "}],"text":"Vice President - Business Development","country":"US","workplaceType":"remote","opening":"","openingPlain":"","descriptionBody":"

    About Zeta:

    Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 

    Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 

     

    About the Role:

    About Zeta:

    Zeta is a globally recognized next-gen banking technology company. Our modern platforms enable financial institutions and fintechs to launch extensible and compliant banking asset and liability products spanning cards, loans, and deposits. Our cloud-native and fully API-enabled stack supports processing, issuing, lending, core banking, fraud, loyalty, digital banking, and agentic AI solutions amongst many other capabilities. 

    Zeta has 1700+ employees with over 70% in technology roles across locations in the US, Middle East, and Asia - representing one of the largest and most capable teams ever assembled in banking tech. Globally, customers have issued 30M+ cards on Zeta's platform expected to grow to 60M+ in the coming years. Most recently valued at $2B, Zeta counts Softbank, Mastercard, and Optum amongst its investors. 

     

    About the Role 

    Zeta solves hard problems for financial institutions. We assemble solutions from our processing, issuing, payments, lending, core, and digital banking platforms to answer a problem an institution could not solve with what it already owns. 

    Every processor now says modern, API-first, and cloud-native, so the words no longer separate vendors. Buyers compare proof, and each alternative asks them to accept a compromise: a provider too old to move fast, one too new to trust with credit, or a program that is never really theirs. 

    This role joins two jobs that are usually split. The first is product: deciding which solutions go to banks, sponsor banks, and fintechs, how they are packaged and priced, and what gets built next. The second is solutions engineering: discovery, target architecture, proofs, and defending the design through architecture, security, and procurement review. 

    You hold both jobs with equal weight: product owner for a defined portfolio of solutions, and the person who proves them in the room. You own the strategy for your solutions and the case for what the platform builds next, and you keep every deal from becoming a custom build. This is a hands-on, 0 to 1 role with no team at the start but requires mentoring and working teams of engineers and product managers.  

    ","id":"e6a9edb6-0db3-4814-a5e7-5814339928ee","lists":[{"text":"Responsibilities","content":"

    Know the Stack 

    • Learn the full Zeta stack hands-on, from issuing across credit, debit, and prepaid to core banking, lending, payments, fraud, and agentic AI end to end 

    • Reach the depth of the teams that build it: modules, APIs, low-code extension points, events, data model, and deployment, each used yourself the way a customer or engineer would 

    Own the Solution 

    • Set the product strategy for your portfolio: which segments and recurring problems to serve, which solutions to build, and which to refuse or retire 

    • Design the product, not only the architecture, for a named institution: customer, proposition, program structure, economics, compliance model, and operating model, before any integration is written 

    • Settle who carries each obligation in a bank and fintech program (onboarding, underwriting, monitoring, disputes, reporting), in writing a bank's compliance officer will sign 

    • Build the business case beside the technical one: unit economics, fees, reserves, and more 

    • Turn the second and third engagement of the same shape into a packaged solution with a defined scope, price logic, positioning, and launch checklist, then run it with its own roadmap and adoption measures 

    • Close the loop with the market: win and loss reviews, customer discovery, and usage, feeding product requirements and the case to the platform teams for what gets built next 

    Discovery, Architecture, and Coexistence 

    • Run technical discovery inside large estates and find the problem worth solving 

    • Produce the target architecture and integration design against the institution's existing core, ledger, data, and channel systems, as one proposition across several platforms, with clear scope now and later 

    • Design coexistence and phasing: what moves first, what runs in parallel, what is decommissioned 

    • Design side-by-side, product-by-product conversion paths for programs and banks with an existing book, scoped with delivery teams 

    Demos and Proofs 

    • Build and maintain demo environments across credit, prepaid, and debit, for new programs and conversions, showing the workflows a customer actually runs 

    • Run proofs of concept and bake-offs against criteria you helped the customer write 

    Enterprise Evaluation and Oversight 

    • Own technical RFP and RFI responses, security questionnaires, and vendor due diligence 

    • Carry the case through architecture review, security, and procurement 

    • Own the technical answer to sponsor bank oversight: every program visible as it runs, ledger-level access on demand, every action recorded as an event, and complete files in hours. 

    Market Voice, and Handoff 

    • Act as counterpart to a buyer’s technical leadership through evaluation, integration design, and launch 

    • Build sponsor banks and fintech platforms into repeatable channels 

    • Keep a working analysis of the field by cohort: legacy full-stack, modern words on older cores, newer platforms without a scaled revolving book, and program managers with capital 

    • Work with Marketing on positioning and case studies, and speak at industry forums 

    "},{"text":"Key Performance Metrics ","content":"

    What you build and own: 

    • A strategy and roadmap for your solutions portfolio, agreed with the platform roadmap owners and built on win and loss evidence 

    • At least three packaged solutions for recurring institutional problems, each with scope, compliance model, economics, pricing, and launch path written down, and each usable by a seller without you 

    • A demo, reference architecture, and objection log library a new seller can run alone, covering diverse solutions spanning credit, prepaid, and debit 

    • Product requirements traced to named deals, in a form the platform teams can plan against, with proposed roadmap items committed and shipped 

    • At least one banking service provider or sponsor bank partner whose own team can position and demonstrate our capability unaided 

    What you contribute to: 

    • Qualified institutions reaching technical evaluation, wins in proofs of concept, and new RFP and shortlist inclusion 

    • At least one seven-figure ARR contract, with a technically qualified pipeline behind it 

    • At least one program live on a solution you designed 

    • One conversion of an existing book, from first technical conversation to signed decision 

    • One institutional reference willing to talk to another bank's architects 

    "},{"text":"Experience and Qualifications ","content":"

    • 15+ years across technology and commercial roles, combining more than one of engineering, product, solutions engineering, and customer success, in banking or fintech 

    • Owned a product or solution line across strategy, roadmap, packaging, pricing, and launch 

    • Defined or launched a financial product with a bank, sponsor bank, fintech, or payments company, from compliance review to live customers 

    • Sold or built technology for US banks, credit unions, fintechs, program managers, or sponsor banks, carrying deals through architecture, security, and procurement review, with a working grasp of sponsor bank oversight and third-party risk 

    • Hands-on card issuing and processing, with credit depth strongly preferred: revolving balances, interest and fee logic, delinquency, and the ledger beneath them 

    • Breadth across at least 2 of core, deposits, payments, cards, lending, and digital 

    • Preferred: running a product or solutions function at a sponsor bank, bank-fintech platform, or payments company; core migration in a live institution; a technical degree 

     
     
    "},{"text":"Skills","content":"
     

    • Product judgment: decide what to build for one, what to package for many, and what to refuse, and say why to a customer who wants all three 

    • Market sense: turn buyer, competitor, and win and loss evidence into a position, price, and roadmap 

    • Program, compliance, and economics fluency: read a bank-fintech arrangement as a sponsor bank's risk officer does, and design interest, fees, interchange, and reserves into a product that holds up 

    • Technical breadth with depth: command the architecture, APIs, and data model across enough of the stack to assemble one proposition from several platforms 

    • Architectural judgment: design a target state, sequence the path, and defend both live against an institution's architects 

    • Executive presence: brief a bank's board sponsors and a founder's investors in one week, then hold your own with engineers 

    • Ownership: thrive in a 0 to 1 motion with no team at the start, and hold the line with the platform teams by making the case
